label: RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_1: receipt as passion, being given esse at a moment in a receiving principle
term: receives esse at a moment, as passion (Lean `passionReceipt`)
definition: passionReceipt G E: z receives x's esse at t in history v iff x's esse is received in z (E x z, DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN) and something gives x being at t (exists g, G.GivesAt v g x t, definition 158301bc). Receiving is read as the passive correlate of an occurrent giving: the patient's side of one exercise of causation, as the air is illumined while the sun illumines. A defined interpretation of the primitive present-tense receipt (definition 506ea036), not a further primitive. On this sense correlativity of receiving and giving holds by definition, and the present-tense reading of reception is equivalent to weak concurrent actualization 40a97664 (result passionReadingIsTheCrux).
note: Analyst reading, attribution deferred. The model is the Aristotelian thesis that action and passion are one actuality, in the patient (Physics III.3); that thesis is not read or pinned here and is cited only for the shape of the reading. Distinguished from RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_2 (standing composition), which requires no giving. Would be sourced by a passage that calls the creature's continuing reception of esse a passion or being-acted-on at each moment.
